verdict.rationale: Vue's docs claim a compiler-optimized, rarely-needs-manual-tuning rendering system and an ecosystem (Router, Vuex/Pinia) built for scaling teams, and some users report happy long-term adoption at scale (vue-comm-9, vue-comm-15). But multiple hands-on developers report Vue becomes harder to maintain in complex apps, with 'magical' behavior, weak TypeScript typing, and state-modularity problems in large codebases (vue-comm-7, vue-comm-18, vue-comm-19, vue-comm-3, vue-comm-17), directly contradicting the 'stays maintainable as it grows' claim.
